title: Classic-V

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Arai Classic-V is engineered for warm-weather riding with featherweight crown comfort. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1148g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~98 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Heritage styling with modern Arai protection.

variants.title: Arai Classic-V Matte Black
variants.description: The Arai Classic-V is a benchmark Open Face helmet crafted in Japan 🇯🇵. Built around Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Optimized for urban commuters and retro cruisers, offering lightweight agility, wide peripheral vision, and step-through convenience. Handcrafted without compromise in Japan for ultimate rider safety.

product_details.description: Heritage styling with modern Arai protection.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Arai's Open Face lineup, the Classic-V brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The Arai Classic-V represents Arai's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Arai Classic-V delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Arai Classic-V Matte Black (matte finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Arai Classic-V in Arai Classic-V Matte Black. A classic open-cranial helmet offering featherweight comfort and effortless cool for relaxed scenic rides.
variants.fitment_notes: Sculpted for Intermediate Oval head shapes with low-profile ear pockets and open-cranial comfort lining. Minimal break-in required with instant pressure-free crown seating.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Classic Arai fit; slightly narrow at the temples and snug around the cheeks for a secure hold without excessive padding. Designed for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Features Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection paired with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports. The interior utilizes One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Arai Classic-V: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports and One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Arai Classic-V: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Arai Classic-V. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner engineered for open-air comfort and easy maintenance.
real_world_pros: Unrestricted 180-degree panoramic field of view for scanning traffic
Featherweight shell construction eliminates neck fatigue on casual rides
Plush, fully removable and washable moisture-wicking crown liner
real_world_cons: Open-face configuration lacks lower chin bar impact protection
Elevated cockpit wind noise at highway speeds requires earplugs
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Arai Classic-V is a benchmark Open Face helmet, engineered to deliver verified safety and all-day acoustic comfort.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Wide-vision jet shield with opti-clear optical clarity and optional peak sun deflection.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low (Snug, even pressure distribution across forehead without hot-spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
